metadata.short_desc: Let AI browse Douyin, comment and reply to comments
metadata.desc: Logs in to your Douyin (Chinese TikTok) account and lets the AI browse the recommended feed, comment in your persona and reply to comments on your own videos. Includes a review queue (on by default), daily limits, active hours, a dashboard page and one-click updates.

dashboard.title: Douyin AI
dashboard.description: Log in to Douyin, review AI comments, watch activity and adjust settings.
